Thanks Tim — good notes. I made two quick edits in the Drive version (linked below): tightened the eval metric list and added an initial prompt set for your QA team. TL;DR on the evaluation plan we recommend:

- Phase A (Canary eval): 48-hour window, run live traffic against shadow endpoint + 3 targeted prompt groups (triage, intake triage, appointment routing)
- Phase B (Pilot): 2-week expanded sample with SLO gates: P95 latency < 350ms, error rate < 0.5%, quality regressions < 3% on flagged prompt set
- Acceptance: sign-off by Novus Ops + Redwood CS

I've also attached an initial training schedule (training-schedule-v1.ics) with recommended 90-min sessions for ops and 60-min for clinicians.
